# mydrive: Drive on docker compose

Generated by `drive init --target compose --delivery presigned --image ghcr.io/shibukawa/streamuploader-drive:v0.1.0 --name mydrive --port 18080`. The Drive runs all-in-one (upload
intake, Drive API, web UI, indexer loop and search sidecar in one container)
against a local RustFS bucket.

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `.env` | every setting; compose.yaml reads it and passes it to the drive container |
| `compose.yaml` | services drive, rustfs |
| `security.yaml` | streamuploader intake policy, a copy of config/security.yaml at generation time |

## Run

```bash
docker compose up -d
```

Open http://localhost:18080/ for the web UI. The RustFS console is at
http://localhost:9001/ with the credentials from `.env`. The bucket is
created on first start.

## Check

These are the m1 completion checks of the Drive. The scripts live in the
streamuploader checkout; the first seeds three fixtures through the API,
the second checks folder listing, the Japanese page hit, the preview and,
with `DRIVE_CHECK_REBUILD=1`, a rebuild from the bucket after deleting the
index volume.

```bash
scripts/drive-demo-seed.sh http://localhost:18080
DRIVE_CHECK_REBUILD=1 scripts/drive-compose-check.sh http://localhost:18080
```

By hand: the three seeded files appear in the `inbox` folder of the UI
within one indexer cycle; searching for `大阪湾の人工島` returns
`kuko-3pages.pdf` with page 3 as the best hit; opening that hit shows the
document preview at page 3 and opening `photo.jpg` shows the image.

## Operate

```bash
docker compose logs -f drive                       # access and indexer logs
curl -X POST http://localhost:18080/api/drive/admin/reindex   # rebuild the index from the bucket
docker compose down                                # stop, keep the bucket and the index cache
docker compose down -v                             # stop and delete every object
```

## Notes

- Delivery mode is `presigned`. Browsers fetch
  objects from `SU_S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT` directly, so that endpoint must be
  reachable from the browser and the bucket needs a CORS rule that allows
  range requests for the document viewer.
- The `drive-index` volume is a cache. Deleting it forces a rebuild from
  the bucket at the next start.
- All settings are environment variables of streamuploader (`SU_*`) and the
  Drive (`DRIVE_*`); see the Drive section of the streamuploader README.
